name: GlowHost
tagline: US-based cPanel hosting built for agencies, resellers and growing sites
description: GlowHost is a US cPanel hosting provider offering shared, reseller, VPS and dedicated plans with a 91-day money-back guarantee and agency-friendly reseller tools.
about: GlowHost runs on standard cPanel with CloudLinux underneath, which sets it apart from budget hosts that build their own custom control panel. Shared hosting comes in four main tiers: Unlimited Single Domain (one site, unlimited storage/bandwidth on SATA drives), Unlimited Multi-Domain (unlimited sites, same SATA-based unlimited storage), Personal Hosting (10GB SSD storage, unlimited sites, 100GB bandwidth) and Professional Hosting (20GB SSD storage, unlimited sites, 250GB bandwidth).

Introductory pricing starts under $4/month on the Unlimited Single Domain plan, with Unlimited Multi-Domain, Personal and Professional tiers stepping up from there — each renews at a noticeably higher monthly rate once the first term ends, so it's worth checking the renewal price shown at checkout before committing to a long prepaid term. Beyond shared hosting, GlowHost also runs reseller hosting (WHMCS-compatible, starting around $24.95/month for its entry Level I plan), semi-dedicated, managed cloud/VPS, and fully dedicated servers — making it a reasonable fit for web design agencies that need to host client sites under one reseller account.

All shared and reseller packages ship with cPanel/WHM, CloudLinux OS, Softaculous one-click installs (WordPress and 300+ other apps), a free SSL certificate, and GlowHost's own OptimumCache caching layer aimed at faster page loads. Shared servers are U.S.-based only, so international customers wanting other regions will need GlowHost's VPS or dedicated lineup instead.
policies: GlowHost backs its hosting plans with a 91-day money-back guarantee — longer than the 30-day window most hosts offer — letting new customers cancel a shared or reseller plan for a refund well after the first month if it isn't working out. As with most hosts, refund terms can exclude domain registration fees and certain add-ons, so it's worth checking GlowHost's current terms for your specific plan before purchasing.
